company.shortDescription: 21Doctors is an online healthcare platform focused on facilitating appointment bookings with a network of specialized doctors.
company.description: 21Doctors is an online healthcare platform focused on facilitating appointment bookings with a network of specialized doctors located in Amman, Jordan. It showcases a curated list of distinguished physicians across diverse medical specialties, including dermatology, dentistry, psychiatry, neurology, orthopedics, ENT, plastic surgery, bariatrics, pulmonology, ophthalmology, natural breastfeeding support, and cosmetic laser treatments. The platform aims to make healthcare access seamless by providing detailed information about each specialist, making it easier for patients to find and book consultations with trusted medical professionals in their area. This service promotes streamlined patient-doctor connections within the local healthcare ecosystem in Amman.
